title: Halo-Halo with Jackfruit and Coconut
description: A Filipino-inspired dessert made with jackfruit, coconut, and a variety of fruits and creamy condiments.

ingredients.name: halo-halo mix-ins (e.g., sweetened beans, kaong, leche flan)

instructions: Combine coconut milk, sugar, and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add ube halaya, ube powder, and jackfruit to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
In a separate bowl, mix together halo-halo mix-ins and ice.
Divide the mixture among individual serving cups.
Pour the cooled jackfruit mixture over the top of the mixture in each cup.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Serve chilled and garnish with additional ube powder, if desired.
